node.label: VB-G RAM G (rural jobs)
node.summary: The rural employment guarantee scheme that replaced MGNREGA in 2026.

facts.text: MGNREGA's accountability rested on **social audit** by the Gram Sabha (Section 17 of the old Act).
facts.plain: MGNREGA's accountability rested on social audit by the Gram Sabha (Section 17 of the old Act).

facts.text: Dropped from the May draft: an FIR when there's prima facie financial irregularity, and action-taken reports to local bodies. Critics say this weakens deterrence and local oversight.
facts.plain: Dropped from the May draft: an FIR when there's prima facie financial irregularity, and action-taken reports to local bodies. Critics say this weakens deterrence and local oversight.

facts.text: New grievance rules (Rural Development Ministry): complaints on any matter, logged online the same or next day, inquiry within **7 days**, resolution within **15 days** or escalation.
facts.plain: New grievance rules (Rural Development Ministry): complaints on any matter, logged online the same or next day, inquiry within 7 days, resolution within 15 days or escalation.

facts.text: **VB-G RAM G** = Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin). It replaced **MGNREGA** in 2026 under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.
facts.plain: VB-G RAM G = Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin). It replaced MGNREGA in 2026 under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.
